ai.seo_question: What is the significance of 'nafs al-baqā' (the breath of life) in Shia eschatology?
ai.summary: Imam Ali (AS) delivers this urgent exhortation in the context of preparing for the Hereafter, emphasizing the transient nature of life ('nafs al-baqā') and the certainty of the Day of Judgment where records are displayed. This passage reflects the Shia emphasis on balancing hope in divine mercy with the fear of the finality of death, urging believers to act before the 'doors of repentance' are sealed, a concept deeply rooted in eschatological traditions.
